finite_assessment.translation_notes: Recursu is the recurrence of the feast, not merely time within Easter. Sacratae tibi modifies the people consecrated to God. Digna intellegentia is worthy insight. The three passive clauses preserve their distinct washing, Spirit and blood instruments and redeemed/born-anew/cleansed senses. Full Father-addressed conclusion and separate response are rendered; neither is expanded from the old Per. without the independent formula source.
